description:
Priority: P0 (build/style). File: .cargo/config.toml. Reference: keystore.

Problem: No single canonical clippy command shared by bacon, CI, and local runs. The file currently contains only [net].

Change: Append an [alias] section:
  [net]
  git-fetch-with-cli = true

  [alias]
  clippy-strict = "clippy --all-targets --workspace -- -D warnings"

Acceptance: `cargo clippy-strict` runs and fails on any warning.
Paired with: TPL-004 (bacon job) and TPL-006 (clippy-flow Makefile task) must point at this alias so all three surfaces agree.
title: [TPL-003] Add a clippy-strict cargo alias
